answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has achieved great success ... which generates accurate and fluent translation ...

answer_2.quote: We measure the case-sensitive BLEU scores using multi-bleu.perl ...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 100 sentences from the test set of WMT19 Zh→En. Then we invite three annotators to evaluate the translation adequacy and fluency. Five scales have been set up, i.e., 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored each translation on adequacy (relevance to source) and fluency (naturalness) using a 1‑5 scale.
